mootSayLines.text: They're named, every one: Hana Rhee, Omar Marsh. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.
They waited three days at the edge of your fire. Nobody called the moot. Hana nods — not angry, just done — and they walk.
